item.title: Student Organizer, QTPO 2026
item.description: I’m serving as Student Organizer for QTPO 2026 — “Quantum Technologies for Precision Oncology: From Drug Discovery to Radiation Therapy,” held November 5–6, 2026 in Washington, DC, alongside my advisor Dr. Mohammadhossein Mohammadisiahroudi (UMBC), a main organizer.

item.title: ACCESS Proposal Accepted
item.description:
Our proposal to ACCESS — the NSF-funded national cyberinfrastructure program — has been accepted. The project, “Quantum-inspired GPU-accelerated Algorithms for Scientific Computing” (MTH260091), is awarded 200,000 ACCESS Credits for Aug 11, 2026 – Aug 10, 2027.

I am Co-PI on the project, with my advisor Dr. Mohammadhossein Mohammadisiahroudi (UMBC) as PI.
